notes: First release. Turns one of the user's spaces into a shareable MusePack: inspects the live space (surface inventory and actions from the source, never from memory), interviews the creator on fidelity (optional reference screenshots in assets/), proposes the fixed-vs-asked split, runs a blocking surface-and-ask privacy gate over every candidate personal item (default exclude), settles companion skills, side chats, schedules, connectors and capabilities, then generates a complete data-only pack in the current format — all five declaration files always present, integrity hashes computed last — validates it against the creation gate, and reports the guarded install prompt plus a catalog entry.
